changes.now: Bullseye kills Foggy Nelson, and Matt Murdock gives up the mask. A year later, Wilson Fisk is elected mayor and builds a task force to wipe out vigilantes, with corrupt police wearing the Punisher's skull. Matt is pulled back in. When Fisk puts the city under martial law, Matt puts the mask back on and starts gathering allies.
changes.proposed: Bullseye kills Foggy Nelson, and Matt Murdock gives up the mask. A year later, Wilson Fisk is elected mayor and builds a task force to wipe out vigilantes, with corrupt police wearing the Punisher's skull. Matt is pulled back in and puts the mask back on to save Angela del Toro from the serial killer Muse. When Fisk puts the city under martial law, Matt starts gathering allies.
changes.evidence: Matt suits up as Daredevil again in episode 6 to rescue Angela del Toro from Muse, and fights as Daredevil in later episodes (Muse at Glenn's office, the ball). Martial law comes only in the finale, after which he recruits Cherry, Kim and honest police; he does not first put the mask back on then.

owner_calls.question: The recap says Frank is 'numbing himself with drugs and alcohol'. Neither plot summary mentions drugs or alcohol: he is shown haunted by hallucinations (Curtis Hoyle, Karen Page) and nearly takes his own life at his family's graves. Keep the phrase or change it?
options: Keep as is (if it is on screen)
Change to: 'Frank Castle has given up being the Punisher and is haunted by visions of his past.'
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia and MCU Fandom plot sections: Castle locks up his gear, is haunted by hallucinations, and puts a gun to his head at the cemetery; no drug or alcohol use described.
